faqs.question: What is in Fit Monk Honey Dryfruits?
faqs.answer: Assorted crunchy dry fruits and seeds steeped in natural Kashmiri honey.

faqs.question: Is this safe for infants?
faqs.answer: No. Natural honey carries a risk of infant botulism and must never be fed to children under 1 year of age.
